item.text: The initial screen is borderline: Schwarz P sheets come close, but no design is certified yet. I’m searching for a candidate that meets both limits after accounting for numerical uncertainty. The tools assess elastic performance; LPBF manufacturability is outside their scope.

The search found a Schwarz P sheet candidate at about 14.88% relative density, with an estimated C44 of 5.65 GPa. I’m running the higher-resolution certification to check it against both requirements.

item.text: Released a certified 316L Schwarz P sheet unit cell with density parameter 0.148784: relative density ≤14.880% and C44 ≥5.482 GPa, meeting both limits. Certification covers ideal geometry; the tested erosion offset fails robustness, and LPBF manufacturability remains unevaluated.
